votes.motion: Approve work session meeting minutes of Tuesday, May 5, 2020; Tuesday, June 11, 2020; Tuesday, July 7, 2020; and Tuesday, August 11, 2020 as well as the formal meeting minutes of Tuesday, December 8, 2020 and the special formal meeting minutes of Friday, December 11, 2020.
votes.description: Approval of multiple prior meeting minutes including four work session minutes and two formal meeting minutes from 2020.

votes.motion: Close and refer items B1-B3 to a future Consent agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on three grant applications (Halfway Houses, Paul Coverdell Forensic Science, and Jordan River Vegetation Improvement) and refers them to a future consent agenda for action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the ordinance requiring notice for permits to work in the public way and defer action to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed ordinance that would require permit holders to notify adjacent property owners about above-ground work in the public right-of-way, deferring final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the hearing and adopt Ordinance 1 of 2021, Budget Amendment No. 6 in its entirety.
votes.description: Adopts the FY2020-21 Budget Amendment No. 6, which includes funding for the Fisher Mansion Carriage House, Glendale Waterpark redevelopment plan, trailhead property acquisition, temporary emergency winter shelter, and Police Department staffing needs, among other changes.

votes.motion: Lift the hiring freeze within Budget Amendment No. 6 to fill the 40% vacancy in the Police Department.
votes.description: Lifts the Police Department hiring freeze as part of Budget Amendment No. 6, authorizing the filling of positions to address a 40% vacancy rate in the department.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 1 of 2021 authorizing the issuance of subordinate airport revenue short-term revolving obligations not to exceed $300 million for the Salt Lake City Department of Airports.
votes.description: Authorizes a short-term borrowing program via a revolving line of credit up to $300 million through JPMorgan Chase for the Department of Airports to finance and refinance capital improvements to Salt Lake City International Airport.

Approves multiple consent items including setting public hearing dates, approving Grant Holding Account Items (Batch No. 3) for FY2020-21, and confirming board appointments for Ginger Cannon (PNUT), Durga Ekambaram (Cultural Core Budget Committee), Stewart Soleman (Bicycle Advisory Committee), Sonali Loomba (Arts Council), and Nico Dicou (Arts Council).
